objective: Determine whether zero certificate-accepted evolved coverage is caused by non-cumulative probe composition or by insufficient non-leaking source-effect support.

stage_1_existing_evidence_recomposition.selection_rule: Use the latest already-materialized counterexample-driven successor for each primitive mechanism and compose all successors cumulatively. Do not inspect target-local effect signs to choose a path.
stage_1_existing_evidence_recomposition.success_criterion: At least one held-out IRG fold passes the unchanged transfer certificate.

stage_2_minimal_new_evidence_rule.activation: Run only if stage 1 has zero accepted folds.
priority: mixed source-effect signs requiring a collision-disambiguating probe
stage_2_minimal_new_evidence_rule.budget_rule: Collect only the smallest mechanism-specific probe campaign or settled source-effect confirmation needed to make one prespecified fold certificate-evaluable. No certificate threshold may be changed after observing results.

claim_boundary: This recovery study may establish nonzero certificate coverage only. It cannot establish improved collision rate until the independently frozen collision labels are rerun on accepted folds.
